memory_candidates.content: In BimodalLogic, F φ is definitionally untl top φ and G φ is (F ¬φ).neg, so UT (Fφ → U(⊤,φ)) is an identity and UE ((φUψ) → Fψ) is one UG instance with TN of φ → ⊤; TL follows from CN by first enriching Fφ/Fψ with UF so CN's shared guard carries the linearity information, and DN (GGφ → Gφ) follows from NN by driving the Until guard to ⊥ (UG+UF+UE) and the event to ⊤ (UC), yielding X⊤, which NN refutes.

Before using derivable_of_validZTime/QTime to derive a schema that is being removed from the Axiom inductive, grep the engine subtrees (Metalogic/BXCanonical, Core, WeakCanonical, Bundle) for the constructor: the Dense engine uses only dense_indicator and the ZTime engine only prior_UZ, which is what makes the detour non-circular.
